|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Use 1 Force: ▼(or retrieve from Lost Pile) Obi-Wan, Obi-Wan's Lightsaber, or Obi-Wan's Cape. OR While Inner Strength not on table, use 1 Force to cancel a weapon, duel or lightsaber combat destiny draw targeting Obi-Wan.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Return Of A Jedi (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Use 1 Force to deploy (or retrieve) Obi-Wan, Obi-Wan’s Cape, or Obi-Wan’s Lightsaber from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Unless Inner Strength on table, use 1 Force to cancel a just drawn weapon destiny targeting Obi-Wan (or a just drawn duel or lightsaber combat destiny if Obi-Wan is participating).” '''What changed:''' “Force: ▼(or retrieve” → “Force to deploy (or retrieve) Obi-Wan, Obi-Wan’s Cape, or Obi-Wan’s Lightsaber”; “Lost Pile) Obi-Wan, Obi-Wan's Lightsaber, or Obi-Wan's Cape.” → “Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”; “While” → “Unless”; removed “not”; “weapon,” → “just drawn weapon destiny targeting Obi-Wan (or a just drawn”; “draw targeting Obi-Wan.” → “if Obi-Wan is participating).”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards2.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown); page 2, slip 20. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Return Of A Jedi]].
* Later text: [[Return Of A Jedi (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Return Of A Jedi (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Return Of A Jedi]].
